summary: Horse-race betting window ("uma"): five mode rows, odds/prize/select panes, the win_gold status window and the per-entry option table. Owned by the menu/uma screen; built by Ui_UmaWindow_Ctor 0x004CCC34.
evidence: Vtable installed by Ctor 0x004CCC34 (allocation 0x90C = 2316 bytes); panel names menu_uma_main/prize/select, win_gold, uma_course1/2_mask; ApplyMode row stride 0x70 over five rows. Several batch offsets come from the embedded panel sub-objects (vtables 0x77A104/0x77A0B4), so field confidence is uneven.
